props.label: What is a CCTV drain inspection?
props.html:
What it is

What is a CCTV drain inspection?

A CCTV drain inspection uses a small waterproof camera on a flexible rod that we feed through your drain or sewer. It sends back a live video feed, so instead of guessing what is wrong we can see the exact cause and location of the problem.

It takes the guesswork out of drain work. You find out whether it is a simple blockage, a build-up, a crack, a collapsed section or tree roots, and exactly where it sits, so the repair is targeted and priced accurately.

props.label: When you need a CCTV drain inspection
props.html:
When you need it

When you need a CCTV drain inspection

A camera survey is worth it whenever you need certainty. Common reasons:

  • A drain keeps blocking and you want to know why
  • Before buying a property, to check the pipes
  • Before pipe relining, to confirm it is the right fix
  • To locate a blockage, crack or collapse
  • To check for tree root intrusion
  • To inspect new or renovated drainage

props.label: What the camera finds
props.html:
What it shows

What the camera finds

A survey shows the condition of the whole line, not just the blockage.

Tree root intrusion

Roots entering through cracks and joints.

Cracks and fractures

Damage that lets water leak and roots in.

Collapsed sections

Pipe that has lost its shape and needs replacing.

Grease and build-up

Fat, scale and debris narrowing the pipe.

Exact location

Where the problem sits and how deep it is.

Overall condition

A clear picture before any repair decision.
